release_name: Roar India Browser v1.0.1 (Privacy Isolation Release)
changelog: Strict Per-User Privacy Isolation: User profile, history, bookmarks, and sessions stored in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Roar Browser\User Data
Zero Developer Data Leakage: Completely clean sandbox for each user on any PC
Fixed Multi-Instance Navigation: Double-clicking browser launches a new tab seamlessly inside existing window
Top Navigation UX: Re-architected user profile placement in header and settings
In-Browser Update Check: Seamless non-intrusive update detection without interrupting current browsing
